[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips to improve shading skills, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Start with basic forms like spheres or cubes to understand light and shadow.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Study values and use a value scale to create a range of lightness and darkness.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Practice varying pressure on the pencil to create different shades.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Use blending tools like blending stumps, tortillons, or fingers for smooth transitions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Use reference images to study how light interacts with objects.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Get feedback from other artists or take a class for critiques on shading techniques.
